properties.name: Thickness
properties.description: Wall thickness. 0 builds the air space as a solid body instead of a hollow shell

properties.name: NeckSize
properties.description: Equivalent AHU/fan discharge or return connection diameter used only for the pressure-loss calculation, referenced to velocity at this neck -- not a separate geometric profile; the generated body's own interface is always the connected duct port's real profile

properties.name: LossCoefficient
properties.description: Pressure-loss coefficient K, referenced to velocity at the neck (0 = no loss modeled at this connection; the fan's own required static pressure is read from the critical-path result instead)

properties.name: TrimNeck
properties.description: Length of the straight collar between the body and the duct

properties.name: BodyLength
properties.description: Axial length of the generic terminal body
